entries.issue: Whether the 1999/2011 material currently substitutes NSR-10.
entries.resolution: Official 2014, June 2026 v3 and July 2026 proposed-POT sources do not establish adoption. This remains visible context, while source-explicit technical calculation is enabled without claiming substitution of NSR-10.

entries.issue: None of the six locked official sources states return periods for the two historical hazards.
entries.productHandling: Return period is machine-readable null; no national or reference-site value is substituted.

entries.issue: The rising branch 0 < T < T0 is drawn but not defined algebraically.
entries.productHandling: T < T0 returns a typed unsupported result; T0 through 4 seconds remains calculable.

entries.issue: The 2011 letter is scoped to public entities and its current administrative effect is not established.
entries.productHandling: Retain the scope finding as context; do not use it as a whole-study computation gate.

entries.issue: The fill and transition clauses require a detailed/site-specific study under the ‘artículo cuarto del presente decreto’, but that article and its method are absent from the locked 24-page support package.
entries.productHandling: Warn affected sites and do not fabricate the absent method; ordinary manual-zone calculation remains available.
